title: PCR Setup for Custom qPCR on OT-2
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 interface, input all required protocol parameters as prompted before starting the run.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided source and unzip the files if they are compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required labware JSON files (e.g., for the 96‑well source plates or 384‑well destination plate).

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with the .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck exactly as shown in the deck map, placing up to four 96‑well source plates and one 384‑well destination plate in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR mastermix manually
steps.instruction: Prepare the qPCR mastermix manually (according to your experimental design) and place it where the OT‑2 can access it for transfer to each reaction well.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette following the standard calibration workflow; refer to the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to start the automated qPCR preparation.

steps.title: Retrieve output CSV file
steps.instruction: After the run completes, launch a Jupyter Notebook server on the robot (see the OpenTrons support article for instructions). Download the generated .csv file, which is named after the 9000‑plate barcode scan followed by “.csv”.
